verdict.rationale: Onboarding status and review is a fair question for a banking-as-a-service product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents a queue showing why an application is pending, a way to supply additional documents, or a split between platform and bank decisions. The only nearby item (docs-22) says platforms 'build and operate controls for account onboarding', which is a fraud-control building block rather than this capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can work the onboarding queue — see why an application is pending, supply additional documents, and understand which decisions are mine versus the bank's
